title: DigitalVehiclePassport
description: The lifecycle record of one vehicle: what it is, what has happened to it, and what backs each statement. An AGGREGATE VIEW, not a stored document — it is assembled per request and filtered to the caller's access scope, so two callers legitimately see two different passports for the same vehicle. Modelled as a W3C credential SUBJECT, never as a credential: a passport aggregates many claims from many issuers over time, whereas a VC is one issuer's signed statement at one time.

scope.description: Which access scope this rendering was filtered to. Present so a consumer knows the view is partial.

credentials.description: W3C Verifiable Credentials issued about this vehicle. See protocol/credentials/.

trust_summary.description: Counts per level. Deliberately NOT a single overall score: a score compresses away exactly the provenance detail a buyer needs, and invites optimising against the score rather than against reality.

completeness_note.description: REQUIRED interpretive guard. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence: a vehicle with no recorded damage has no recorded damage, which is not the same as an undamaged vehicle. Consumers MUST NOT present a passport as a certificate of condition.

qr.description: Every passport has an IDauto QR representation. The QR encodes a resolvable IVID reference ONLY — never personal data, and never a bearer token that would grant access to a restricted view.
